name: Fox Mirage

card.plain: Vanish in a puff of smoke and step out behind your opponent.
card.frames: 18 / — / 10 frames, no damage, teleports behind the opponent

card.plain: Lv 1 → Lv 2: you recover 4 frames faster after stepping out.
card.frames: Lv 1 → Lv 2: recovery -4 (18 / — / 6 frames), no damage, teleports behind the opponent

2.notes: Proposed (open question, A4). Changes how you fight: 6 recovery frames behind the opponent is enough to start a light punch (startup 4) before they turn into a block, so the teleport becomes an opener, not just an escape. Data only, no clip change (F2): the clip's last 4 frames are cut (the clip tail is a blend-out). Alternative if the designer prefers: recovery -3, since the move is only 10 frames and -4 is 40% of it. Startup can't be tuned: teleport.frame is not an effect target.

card.plain: A fox image stays where you vanished and takes one hit for you.
card.frames: 18 / — / 6 frames, decoy absorbs 1 hit, teleports behind the opponent

notes: ONE file serves both fighters: source kitsune (A8), slot D (the Kitsune's other special, Foxfire, is slot C) so Ryo can draft it and the Tanuki can copy it (T0, slot kept on Ryo's side); data identical for either caster (K3); Kihon is slot D + down. Rarity rare + locked from the A11 table (rare = each yokai's second special, A9, offered only by elders). Frames 18/-/10 = rules.md table, no deviation: clip kitsune-fox-mirage is 28 frames (GREYBOX reuse of kitsune-foxfire, raw 31-85 at 2x, route A of YOK-219; clip comparison in its notes); ryo-fox-mirage is the same on Ryo's rig. Active is null: the move never hits; properties.teleport (YOK-224) puts the fighter just behind the opponent on frame 18 (the last startup frame) and turns them round; the 10 recovery frames follow on the far side. Not an invulnerability (E12 reading in Match.Mirage): the fighter is hurtable the whole move. Body hurtbox frames 1-28 = kitsune-foxfire's rigged-pose box (x -30, y 5, w 80, h 315), the same body and the same pose family; the extended hand is not added (sleeves not added, as Foxfire); estimated for this clip, not re-measured from the 2x frames: proposed. No hitbox, damage 0, so no hitstun, blockstun or strength. EX (C5/E16, proposed): costs 1 bar, recovery -2 (Lv 1: 18/-/8, Lv 2: 18/-/4); data-only, my own proposal as the rules list no EX effect for it. Kept small on purpose: Brute Recovery (-4 recovery on block) on a Lv 2 EX Fox Mirage must stay at 0 or more (validate_data), so Lv 2 + EX is the floor of 4. Mirage Feint (Lv 3, A5): sets properties.decoy to 1; the decoy is a frozen idle copy left at the origin (E04, no clip). Lv 3 keeps the Lv 2 step (E17). Presets fox-mirage-lv1 and mirage-feint are named, files are Asset Smith's.
